title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation

output_modality.value: Multi-view driving video generated autoregressively in real time; up to 7 synchronized views, 4 cameras in the main setup.

control_signal.value: Abstract world scenario (lane maps, agent bounding boxes) rendered into a conditioning video using the policy or human driving action; text prompt for weather, lighting, time of day; first-frame RGB.

control_mechanism.value: Lightweight control branch: small MLP encodes simulator state into control tokens concatenated with visual tokens (no ControlNet); text by cross-attention; streaming KV cache gives memory.

base_model.value: Cosmos diffusion model (causal transformer like Cosmos-Predict 2.5), mid- and post-trained on 21k hours of driving, then distilled with Self Forcing and DMD for real-time use.

datasets.value: 21k hours of driving scenarios; quality eval on 1,000 clips from the 5,000-clip held-out split of RDS-HQ-1M; closed-loop on a 501-scene subset of Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec.

metrics.value: FVD, LET-AP/APL/APH from an off-the-shelf detector, and closed-loop incident rates (collision by direction, offroad, All Incidents).

controllability_evidence.value: Fidelity as a simulator: policy ranking by All Incidents under NuRec is preserved under OmniDreams, with OmniDreams WAM best and Alpamayo 1.5 (1 cam) worst, called a faithful proxy.

closed_loop.value: Yes. Rolled out with Alpamayo 1 policy in AlpaSim; 20-second closed-loop rollouts, replanning every 533 ms.

notes: Controllable scenario editing section (9.3.1) is only in the contents; its content is not in the packet. Packet also covers WAM policy post-training and a diffusion fixer, which are side uses.
